items.quote: Peers observed that Wenko Tamason was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of the division's budget planning.
Peers observed that Wenko spearheaded teamwork across departments on the annual review at the national level.
Direct reports said that Wenko Tamason handled adoption of new technology tools for case officers competently within their team.
They set the direction for change management after the merger of two units across the public service.
They headed analytics to guide resource allocation, setting priorities for several teams.
Direct reports said that Wenko took ownership of community engagement on the estate renewal plan and steered it to completion.
Direct reports said that Wenko was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of emergency coordination during the flood response.
Peers observed that Wenko Tamason delivered their share of accountability arrangements for public funds reliably.
